'''Yasooska''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. Like the other inner moon, [[Enak/Legends|Enak]], it was a "true" moon, not a captured [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]].
